name: x2611_15358_thm3_1
statement: (d : ℕ) (K : Geometry.SimplicialComplex ℝ (Fin d → ℝ)) (hfin : K.vertices.Finite) (hT : Nonempty (K.space ≃ₜ (Fin 3 → Circle))) : Nat.card K.vertices ≠ 14
closed: ∀ (d : ℕ) (K : Geometry.SimplicialComplex ℝ (Fin d → ℝ)) (hfin : K.vertices.Finite) (hT : Nonempty (K.space ≃ₜ (Fin 3 → Circle))), Nat.card K.vertices ≠ 14
original: There is no simplicial triangulation of $T^{3}$ on fourteen vertices.
type: ∀ (d : ℕ) (K : Geometry.SimplicialComplex ℝ (Fin d → ℝ)), K.vertices.Finite → Nonempty (↑K.space ≃ₜ (Fin 3 → Circle)) → Nat.card ↑K.vertices ≠ 14

theorem x2611_15358_thm3_1_aux1 {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Nat.card G.edgeSet + Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet = (Fintype.card V).choose 2 := by
  classical
  have h := Finset.card_union_add_card_inter G.edgeFinset (Gᶜ).edgeFinset
  have hu : G.edgeFinset ∪ (Gᶜ).edgeFinset = (⊤ : SimpleGraph V).edgeFinset := by
    ext e
    induction e using Sym2.ind with
    | h a b =>
      simp only [Finset.mem_union, SimpleGraph.mem_edgeFinset,
        SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet, SimpleGraph.compl_adj, SimpleGraph.top_adj]
      have hne := G.ne_of_adj (a := a) (b := b)
      tauto
  have hi : G.edgeFinset ∩ (Gᶜ).edgeFinset = ∅ := by
    ext e
    induction e using Sym2.ind with
    | h a b =>
      simp [SimpleGraph.compl_adj]
      tauto
  rw [hu, hi, Finset.card_empty, add_zero,
    SimpleGraph.card_edgeFinset_top_eq_card_choose_two] at h
  simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, SimpleGraph.card_edgeSet] using h.symm

theorem x2611_15358_thm3_1_aux2 {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (V : Finset α) (F : Finset (Finset α)) (k : ℕ) (w : Finset α → ℤ)
    (hF : ∀ s ∈ F, s ⊆ V ∧ s.card ≤ k) :
    (∑ U ∈ V.powersetCard k, ∑ s ∈ F.filter (fun s => s ⊆ U), w s) =
      ∑ s ∈ F, (Nat.choose (V.card - s.card) (k - s.card) : ℤ) * w s := by
  classical
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s hs
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_filter_powersetCard_subset s V k
    (hF s hs).1 (hF s hs).2]
  simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]

theorem x2611_15358_thm3_1_aux3 {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (k : ℕ) (hcard : Fintype.card α = 2 * k) (f : Finset α → ℤ) :
    (∑ U ∈ Finset.univ.powersetCard k, f Uᶜ) =
      ∑ U ∈ Finset.univ.powersetCard k, f U := by
  have hc : ∀ U ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).powersetCard k,
      Uᶜ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).powersetCard k := by
    intro U hU
    refine Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.card_compl, hcard, (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hU).2]
    omega
  refine Finset.sum_bij (fun U _ => Uᶜ) hc ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro U hU W hW heq
    simpa using congrArg (fun s : Finset α => sᶜ) heq
  · intro U hU
    exact ⟨Uᶜ, hc U hU, by simp⟩
  · intro U hU
    rfl

theorem x2611_15358_thm3_1_aux4 {α : Type*} (S : Finset α) (f : α → ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ a ∈ S, 0 < f a) :
    (∑ a ∈ S, (f a : ℤ)) = (∑ a ∈ S, (f a - 1) : ℕ) + (S.card : ℤ) := by
  have ht : ∀ a ∈ S, (f a : ℤ) = (f a - 1 : ℕ) + (1 : ℤ) := by
    intro a ha
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (hf a ha), Nat.cast_one]
    ring
  calc
    _ = ∑ a ∈ S, (((f a - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1) := Finset.sum_congr rfl ht
    _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]; simp


theorem x2611_15358_thm3_1 (d : ℕ)
    (K : Geometry.SimplicialComplex ℝ (Fin d → ℝ))
    (hfin : K.vertices.Finite)
    (hT : Nonempty (K.space ≃ₜ (Fin 3 → Circle))) : Nat.card K.vertices ≠ 14 := by
  classical
  have inputs :
      (∀ (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 14)),
        (∀ v : Fin 14, 4 ≤ Nat.card (G.neighborSet v)) →
        Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet ≤ 15 → x2611_15358_D G ≤ 64 * Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet) ∧
      (∀ (d' : ℕ) (K' : Geometry.SimplicialComplex ℝ (Fin d' → ℝ))
        (e : Fin 14 ≃ K'.vertices) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 14)),
        Nonempty (K'.space ≃ₜ (Fin 3 → Circle)) →
        (∀ i j : Fin 14, G.Adj i j ↔ i ≠ j ∧
          ({(e i).1, (e j).1} : Finset (Fin d' → ℝ)) ∈ K'.faces) →
        (∀ v : Fin 14, 4 ≤ Nat.card (G.neighborSet v)) ∧ 76 ≤ Nat.card G.edgeSet) ∧
      (∀ (d' : ℕ) (K' : Geometry.SimplicialComplex ℝ (Fin d' → ℝ))
        (e : Fin 14 ≃ K'.vertices) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 14))
        (F : Finset (Finset (Fin 14))),
        Nonempty (K'.space ≃ₜ (Fin 3 → Circle)) →
        (∀ i j : Fin 14, G.Adj i j ↔ i ≠ j ∧
          ({(e i).1, (e j).1} : Finset (Fin d' → ℝ)) ∈ K'.faces) →
        (∀ s : Finset (Fin 14), s ∈ F ↔
          s.image (fun i => (e i).1) ∈ K'.faces) →
        (∀ s ∈ F, s.card ≤ 4) ∧
        (∑ s ∈ F, (Nat.choose (14 - s.card) (7 - s.card) : ℤ) *
          (-1 : ℤ) ^ (s.card - 1)) = 16464 - 252 * (Nat.card G.edgeSet : ℤ)) ∧
      (∀ (d' : ℕ) (K' : Geometry.SimplicialComplex ℝ (Fin d' → ℝ))
        (e : Fin 14 ≃ K'.vertices) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 14))
        (F : Finset (Finset (Fin 14))),
        Nonempty (K'.space ≃ₜ (Fin 3 → Circle)) →
        (∀ i j : Fin 14, G.Adj i j ↔ i ≠ j ∧
          ({(e i).1, (e j).1} : Finset (Fin d' → ℝ)) ∈ K'.faces) →
        (∀ s : Finset (Fin 14), s ∈ F ↔
          s.image (fun i => (e i).1) ∈ K'.faces) →
        ∀ (U : Finset (Fin 14)), U.card = 7 →
          (∑ s ∈ F.filter (fun s => s ⊆ U), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (s.card - 1)) ≤
            (Nat.card (G.induce (↑U : Set (Fin 14))).ConnectedComponent : ℤ) +
            (Nat.card (G.induce (↑Uᶜ : Set (Fin 14))).ConnectedComponent : ℤ) - 4) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    all_goals clear hT hfin K d
    all_goals sorry
  obtain ⟨graph_bound, geometric_bounds, euler_formula, induced_euler⟩ := inputs
  intro h14
  letI : Fintype K.vertices := hfin.fintype
  let e : Fin 14 ≃ K.vertices := (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq
    (show Fintype.card K.vertices = 14 by rwa [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card])).symm
  let p : Fin 14 → (Fin d → ℝ) := fun i => (e i).1
  let G : SimpleGraph (Fin 14) :=
    { Adj := fun i j => i ≠ j ∧ ({p i, p j} : Finset (Fin d → ℝ)) ∈ K.faces
      symm := by
        constructor
        intro i j h
        exact ⟨h.1.symm, by simpa only [Finset.pair_comm] using h.2⟩
      loopless := by
        constructor
        intro i h
        exact h.1 rfl }
  let F : Finset (Finset (Fin 14)) :=
    Finset.univ.filter (fun s => s.image p ∈ K.faces)
  have hG : ∀ i j : Fin 14, G.Adj i j ↔ i ≠ j ∧
      ({(e i).1, (e j).1} : Finset (Fin d → ℝ)) ∈ K.faces := by
    intro i j
    rfl
  have hF : ∀ s : Finset (Fin 14), s ∈ F ↔
      s.image (fun i => (e i).1) ∈ K.faces := by
    intro s
    simp only [F, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, p]
  obtain ⟨hdegree, hm⟩ := geometric_bounds d K e G hT hG
  obtain ⟨hsize, hweighted⟩ := euler_formula d K e G F hT hG hF
  let S : Finset (Finset (Fin 14)) := Finset.univ.powersetCard 7
  let c : Finset (Fin 14) → ℕ := fun U =>
    Nat.card (G.induce (↑U : Set (Fin 14))).ConnectedComponent
  let χ : Finset (Fin 14) → ℤ := fun U =>
    ∑ s ∈ F.filter (fun s => s ⊆ U), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (s.card - 1)
  have hedge := x2611_15358_thm3_1_aux1 G
  norm_num only [Fintype.card_fin, Nat.choose] at hedge
  have hq : Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet ≤ 15 := by omega
  have hupper := graph_bound G hdegree hq
  have hc : ∀ U ∈ S, 0 < c U := by
    intro U hU
    have hcardU : U.card = 7 := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hU).2
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega : 0 < U.card)
    haveI : Nonempty (↑U : Set (Fin 14)) := ⟨⟨v, hv⟩⟩
    exact Nat.card_pos
  have hsumc := x2611_15358_thm3_1_aux4 S c hc
  have hD : (∑ U ∈ S, (c U - 1)) = x2611_15358_D G := rfl
  rw [hD] at hsumc
  have hScard : S.card = 3432 := by
    norm_num [S, Finset.card_powersetCard, Nat.choose]
  rw [hScard] at hsumc
  have hcomplement : (∑ U ∈ S, (c Uᶜ : ℤ)) = ∑ U ∈ S, (c U : ℤ) := by
    exact x2611_15358_thm3_1_aux3 7 (by decide) (fun U => (c U : ℤ))
  have hpointwise : ∀ U ∈ S, χ U ≤ (c U : ℤ) + (c Uᶜ : ℤ) - 4 := by
    intro U hU
    exact induced_euler d K e G F hT hG hF U (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hU).2
  have hsumle := Finset.sum_le_sum hpointwise
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul] at hsumle
  rw [hcomplement, hsumc, hScard] at hsumle
  have hsumχ : (∑ U ∈ S, χ U) = 16464 - 252 * (Nat.card G.edgeSet : ℤ) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ s ∈ F, (Nat.choose (14 - s.card) (7 - s.card) : ℤ) *
          (-1 : ℤ) ^ (s.card - 1) := by
        apply x2611_15358_thm3_1_aux2
        intro s hs
        exact ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, (hsize s hs).trans (by decide)⟩
      _ = _ := hweighted
  rw [hsumχ] at hsumle
  have hupperZ : (x2611_15358_D G : ℤ) ≤ 64 * (Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hupper
  have hedgeZ : (Nat.card G.edgeSet : ℤ) + (Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet : ℤ) = 91 := by
    exact_mod_cast hedge
  have hqZ : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet : ℤ) := Int.natCast_nonneg _
  omega
